pages.text: June 15, 2026 INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (BHU) EVENTS DATES Opening of Online Registration for all students (except First Semester UG/PG/Ph.D. students) Jul 06, 2026 (Mon) Last date for Registration for all students except (First Semester UG/PG/Ph.D. students) Online Jul 17, 2026 (Fri) Physical Jul 22, 2026 (Wed) Start of Classes for all students (except First Semester UG/PG/Ph.D. Students) Jul 23, 2026 (Thu) Last date of receiving overload/underload recommendation from DUGC/DPGC* Jul 23, 2026 (Thu) Last date of Adding of Courses and Locking of Registration Portal Jul 29, 2026 (Wed) Last date for Online Registration & Date of Physical Registration/ Orientation of UG First Semester students Jul 30, 2026 (Thu) [Induction Program from Jul 30-Aug 05, 2026 (Thu-Wed)] Last date for Late Registration (with late fee) Jul 30, 2026 (Thu) Last date for Online Registration & Date of Physical Registration for PG/Ph.D. First Semester Students Jul 31, 2026 (Fri) Classes Begin for UG First Semester Aug 07, 2026 (Fri) Classes Begin for PG/Ph.D First Semester Aug 03, 2026 (Mon) Last Date for withdrawal from any of the courses/Semester Drop Aug 18, 2026 (Tue) Mid Term Examination Sep 21 – 26, 2026 (Mon-Sat) Last Date for Document Submission (PG Students) Sep 18, 2026 (Fri) Display of Mid Term Examination Marks Sep 30, 2026 (Wed) Spardha Oct 09-11, 2026 (Fri-Sun) [Tentative] [Classes will remain suspended on Oct 09 (Fri)] Intra-Semester Recess Oct 17 – 21, 2026 (Sat – Wed) Last date of sending list of Open elective/Departmental Elective/HULM courses for Even Semester 2026-27 to Academic Section by DUGC/DPGC Oct 30, 2026 (Fri) Classes End except UG/PG/Ph.D. First Semester Students Nov 10, 2026 (Tue) UG/PG/Ph.D. First Semester Students Nov 17, 2026 (Tue) End Semester Examination (All exams for B.Tech/B.Arch./IDD III, VII and IX Sem. Students (Other than overload) should be completed by Nov. 26) except First Sem. UG/PG/Ph.D. Students Nov 12 – 25, 2026 (Thu-Wed) First Sem. UG/PG/Ph.D. Students Nov 19–30, 2026 (Thu-Mon) Make-up Examination Dec 01–04, 2026 (Tue – Fri) Last Date for submission of Grades Dec 07, 2026 (Mon) Declaration of End Semester Examination Results Dec 10, 2026 (Thu) Winter Break Dec 01–30, 2026 (Sat – Wed) Allotment of OE/HULM courses for Even Semester 2026-27 Dec 16, 2026 (Mon) Opening of online Class Timetable portal for Even Semester 2026-27 Dec 18, 2026 (Wed) Opening of Online Registration for Even Semester 2026-27 Dec 23, 2026 (Wed) Physical Registration for Even Semester 2026-27 Jan 04, 2027 (Mon) Classes start for Even Semester 2026-27 Jan 05, 2027 (Tue) * Overload/underload recommendations received up to July 21, 2026 must be submitted by July 22, 2026. Note: 1. There will be NO INTRA-SEMESTER RECESS & SEMESTER BREAK for M.Tech., M.Pharm., M.Sc., IDD after 8 th Semester and Ph.D. students. 2. A late fee of Rs. 500/- per day will be charged for late registration. 3. Convocation – November 06, 2026. DEAN (ACADEMIC AFFAIRS)
